content.title: Should Investors Reassess GameStop After Share Price Jumps 10% This Week?
content.summary: GameStop has always been one of those stocks that sparks strong opinions. Whether you are holding tight after years of wild swings or just considering your first buy, it is tough to ignore the recent moves. Within the last week, the share price jumped 10.3%, following an 8.3% uptick over the past month. But step back a bit further, and the year-to-date result tells a different story, with shares down 18.7%. Go back one year or more, and things get even more interesting, with shares up 20.7%...
